title: Chocolate alfajores
hookLine: Uruguayan-inspired chocolate alfajores with 13 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: For the cookies cream the butter with the sugar for a few minutes. Then add the egg and honey and mix well. Add flour, cornstarch, cocoa, baking soda and baking powder and mix until you get a dough. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for at least half an hour or overnight. Incorporate {m53320_1}, {m53320_2}, {m53320_3}, and {m53320_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Preheat & Prep Your Pan
steps.instructionTemplate: Line two baking sheets with parchment paper, preheat oven to 200 degrees Celsius. Mix gently until just combined with no dry streaks remaining, then bake until the edges are golden and a toothpick comes out with moist crumbs. Incorporate {m53320_5}, {m53320_6}, {m53320_7}, {m53320_8}, {m53320_9}, {m53320_10}, {m53320_11}, {m53320_12}, and {m53320_13} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Press Dough Evenly
steps.instructionTemplate: Divide dough into two parts, put one part back in the fridge before using. Roll out second part to about 2 millimeters and cut out round cookies with 5-6 centimeters in diameter. This can be done with a cookie cutter or glass. You should get 30 cookies in total or even more, I get about 40. Bake one baking sheet at the time for about 8-10min. Let cookies cool.

steps.title: Bake Until Golden & Set
steps.instructionTemplate: For the filling look for two cookies of the same size and place about one teaspoon of dulce de leche onto the bottom one before sandwiching together.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Chop semi-sweet chocolate and melt with butter and orange zest on low heat. Dunk each sandwich cookie into the chocolate and let cool off on parchment paper before serving.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Add a pinch of flaky sea salt right as it leaves the oven—it makes the dark chocolate flavor taste 2x richer.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
